clean.brand_line: For carpet, upholstery and home cleaning teams
clean.home_title: Keep your cleaning enquiries on track.
clean.home_description: See which customers need a reply, which quotes need a follow-up and which jobs are confirmed. We set up the forms and tracking around how your team works.
clean.contact_message: Hi Estanza, I’d like to discuss a workflow for my team’s enquiries, quotes and follow-ups.
clean.service_intro: For carpet, upholstery and domestic cleaning businesses tracking enquiries in messages, notebooks or spreadsheets. We set up the enquiry-to-booking process around your team.
clean.service_title: From enquiry to booked cleaning job.
clean.service_description: Keep customer details, quotes and follow-up dates together. We set up a workflow that shows your team who needs a reply and which jobs are ready to book.
clean.audience_title: For teams juggling calls and messages.
clean.audience_body: A customer asks about carpet cleaning by phone. Another sends a message about their sofa. Your team needs the details, a price to send and a way to remember who to follow up. That’s the work we help you organise.
clean.journey_title: A sofa-cleaning enquiry, step by step.
clean.journey_1_body: The customer shares the area, service, number of items and a preferred date. Staff can also enter these details from a call or message.
clean.journey_2: Check the enquiry and prepare a quote
clean.journey_2_body: Your team asks for anything missing, then sets the items and prices. The quote is prepared for the customer to review; it is not a booking.
clean.journey_3: Check availability and book the job
clean.journey_3_body: Once the customer accepts the quote, check team availability and agree a date and time. The original preferred date is not automatically confirmed.
clean.scope_title: What we set up for your team
clean.scope_body: An enquiry form and list, quote details, follow-up dates and a simple job schedule. Staff can enter phone and message enquiries by hand, so customers don’t all have to use the form.
clean.now_body: Add a sample enquiry, prepare a quote, try a customer response and schedule a sample team. Changes last only while you stay on the demo page. No messages are sent.
clean.later_body: Your enquiry channels, staff access, how quotes will reach customers, hosting and support. Any messaging, payment or other integration needs a separate agreed scope; none is connected in this demo.
clean.not_ads: We help you follow up enquiries you already receive. Finding new customers and running adverts sit outside this service.
clean.process_title: Start with the way you work.
clean.process_1_body: Show us how customers get in touch, what you ask before quoting and how you keep track of replies.
clean.process_2: Set up your forms and stages
clean.process_2_body: We tailor the enquiry form, quote details and follow-up stages to your team, using your business name and branding.
clean.process_3_body: We work through sample enquiries together, then agree what you need for day-to-day use, hosting and support.
clean.cost_body: Your setup can include branded enquiry forms, quote tracking, follow-up stages, a simple job schedule and a team walkthrough.
clean.cost_note: We agree the scope and setup price before work starts. Hosting, ongoing support and any paid messaging or integrations are listed separately.
clean.previous_body: Earlier automotive booking demos, available to explore. These are demonstration projects, not client case studies.
clean.automotive_price_note: The prices below belong to the earlier automotive offer and do not apply to the cleaning-company service.
clean.faq_1_q: Does every customer have to use the form?
clean.faq_1_a: No. Your team can enter details from a phone call or message. During setup, we agree how to handle the channels your customers already use.
clean.faq_2_q: Who decides the price of a job?
clean.faq_2_a: You do. Your team reviews the enquiry and sets the items, quantities and prices. The demo adds up the quote; it does not choose your prices.
clean.faq_3_q: Does accepting a quote confirm a booking?
clean.faq_3_a: No. You still check that a team is available, then agree the date and time. A customer’s preferred date is only a request until you confirm it.
clean.faq_4_q: Can I assign enquiries to staff?
clean.faq_4_a: Yes, you can try this with sample staff in the demo. Real staff accounts, access permissions and the number of users are agreed before setup.
clean.faq_5_q: Does the demo send WhatsApp messages or email?
clean.faq_5_a: No. Sending a quote and the customer’s reply are simulated. Copying a follow-up only copies text. Sending real messages would need separately agreed setup.
clean.faq_6_q: Can the fields and follow-up stages be customised?
clean.faq_6_a: Yes. We discuss the details you need to collect and the steps your team follows, then agree the work and its cost. Ongoing support is discussed separately.
clean.contact_title: How do you handle enquiries today?
clean.contact_body: Tell us how customers get in touch, how you prepare quotes and how you track replies. We’ll help you identify a useful starting point.
clean.footer_description: Enquiry, quote and follow-up workflows for service businesses. Set up around your team.
